clinical|clinical equipment|clinical equipment other
	any other type of equipment apart from diagnostic imaging equipment used at the physician clinic for providing healthcare to patients. examples include examination chairs, treatment tables, diagnostic tools, autoclave equipment, medication dispensers, vital sign monitors, and other non-imaging clinical equipment. (medical equipment manufacturers, medical supply distributors, clinical equipment vendors.)
clinical|clinical equipment|diagnostic imaging equipment
	diagnostic imaging equipment suppliers including x-ray machines, ultrasound equipment, ct scanners, mri machines, digital radiography systems, mammography equipment, and related imaging technology. (medical imaging equipment manufacturers (ge healthcare, siemens, philips), imaging equipment vendors, specialized medical device companies.)
clinical|clinical services|clinical services other
	clinical services such as specialized clinical assessments, clinical audits, quality improvement support, clinical protocol development, or other ad-hoc clinical work performed by external clinical consultants or agencies. (clinical consulting firms, healthcare service organizations, specialized clinical service providers.)
clinical|clinical services|clinical staffing
	staffing agencies or independent contractors for temporary labor associated with clinical work like registered nurses, lpns, medical assistants, phlebotomists, respiratory therapists, and other non-physician clinical personnel. (healthcare staffing agencies (aya healthcare, trustaff), clinical temporary labor providers, nursing agencies, medical staffing companies.)
clinical|clinical services|doctor/physician/director fee
	doctors or physicians (that are not on payroll) for their services provided to innovacare, including contracted primary care physicians, specialty consultants, medical directors, peer review services, or advisory services. (independent physician practitioners, physician networks, specialist groups, medical director service providers, locum tenens agencies.)
clinical|clinical services|laboratory services
	laboratory testing services including chemistry, hematology, microbiology, pathology, genetic testing, and specialized lab analysis services for patient samples. (laboratory service providers (labcorp, quest diagnostics, sonic healthcare), hospital labs, specialized reference labs, diagnostic testing companies.)
clinical|clinical services|patient care
	direct patient care services including member support services, care navigation, transportation for medical appointments, wellness programs, community health initiatives, and other direct patient-facing care delivery not categorized elsewhere. (patient transportation services (medical transport companies), patient advocacy organizations, care navigation service providers, member services vendors, community health organizations.)
clinical|clinical supplies|clinical supplies other
	clinical supplies including bandages, wound care products, syringes, needles, diagnostic test kits, gloves, protective equipment, iv supplies, and other consumable clinical supplies used in patient care. (medical supply manufacturers, healthcare distributors (cardinal health, mckesson, henry schein), clinical consumables vendors, pharmaceutical distributors.)
clinical|clinical supplies|medical-surgical supplies
	medical and surgical supplies including sterile instruments, surgical trays, sutures, gauze, dressings, catheters, stents, orthopedic implants, and other surgical/procedural consumables. (surgical supply manufacturers, medical device companies (medtronic, stryker, zimmer), hospital supply distributors, specialty surgical suppliers.)
clinical|it - clinical|clinical decision support tools
	clinical decision support software and ai tools that help physicians with diagnosis, treatment recommendations, drug interactions, evidence-based protocols, and clinical guideline adherence. (ehr vendors with embedded cds (epic, cerner), specialized cds vendors (ibm watson health, tempus ai), healthcare it companies.)
clinical|it - clinical|ehr/emr
	electronic health record (ehr) or electronic medical record (emr) systems and related services including software licenses, maintenance, updates, hosting, integration, and support. (major ehr vendors (epic systems, cerner, athena health, nextgen, practice fusion), cloud-based ehr providers, healthcare it integrators.)
clinical|it - clinical|practice management software
	practice management software systems used for scheduling, billing, patient registration, claims submission, and administrative workflow management across physician clinics. (practice management vendors (athena health, nextgen healthcare, eclinicalworks), integrated ehr/pm vendors, healthcare it service providers.)
clinical|it - clinical|telehealth
	telehealth and virtual care platforms enabling remote consultations, virtual visits, remote patient monitoring, digital therapeutics, and virtual care delivery capabilities. (telehealth platform vendors (teladoc, amwell, mdlive), video conferencing companies adapted for healthcare, healthcare it vendors offering telehealth modules.)
clinical|pharmacy|pharmacy
	pharmacy services including medication management programs, formulary services, drug therapy consulting, medication synchronization programs, or specialized pharmacy services.
